user.title: Create the GitHub App
user.description: Home Assistant creates a private GitHub App with read-only access to issues, pull requests and repository metadata. GitHub then shows it for confirmation and asks which repositories to install it on.

data_description.app_name: Unique across GitHub, at most 34 characters.
data_description.organization: Leave empty to create the app on your personal account.
data_description.route: How GitHub reaches this Home Assistant.

create.title: Create the app on GitHub
create.description: Open GitHub, check the app's name and press Create GitHub App. This dialog continues by itself.

install.title: Install the app
install.description: Install the app on all repositories or a selection. This dialog continues by itself once GitHub returns.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect GitHub Inbox
reauth_confirm.description: GitHub no longer accepts the inbox for {account}: the app was uninstalled, suspended or deleted. Submit to reinstall it, or to create a new app if it was deleted.

reconfigure.title: Webhook route
reconfigure.description: Moves the webhook of {account}'s app. GitHub is told the new address.

error.invalid_name: Give the app a name of at most 34 characters.
error.invalid_organization: That is not a GitHub organization name.
error.route_unavailable: That route cannot carry webhooks now.
error.suspended: The app is suspended on GitHub. Unsuspend it in the account's installed apps, then submit again.

abort.no_route: GitHub cannot reach this Home Assistant: sign in to Home Assistant Cloud or set an external URL.
abort.conversion_failed: GitHub did not hand over the new app's credentials. The code lasts one hour; start again.
abort.cannot_connect: The app is installed but its repositories could not be read.
abort.already_configured: This GitHub account already has an inbox.
abort.wrong_account: The app is installed on a different account than this inbox's.
abort.reconfigure_successful: GitHub now delivers to the new route.

data_description.notify_targets: For example the companion app's mobile_app service. A tap opens the inbox at the item.
data_description.persistent_notification: Also post to Home Assistant's notification list.
data_description.include_bots: Dependabot, Renovate and other bot accounts.
data_description.include_own: Activity by the account that owns the inbox.

options.opened: New and reopened issues and pull requests

auth_failed.message: GitHub no longer accepts this inbox's app or installation.

sync_failed.message: The inbox could not be read from GitHub: {error}

webhook_taken.message: Another integration holds this inbox's webhook id.

webhook_route.title: GitHub cannot reach the inbox for {account}
webhook_route.description: The inbox's webhook route is not available: Home Assistant Cloud is signed out or has no subscription, or the external URL is gone. Restore it, or move the webhook with the integration's Reconfigure.

resync.name: Resync
resync.description: Reads every open issue and pull request from GitHub again. Webhooks keep the inbox current; this recovers from anything they missed.
